ValidationRule.description: Asset Name cannot be editable by any profile other than Integration
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.NSP_AssetValidations__c!=True, NOT(ISNEW()), OR( RecordType.Name = "CPQ Asset", RecordType.Name = "WO", RecordType.Name = "RET WO"), ISCHANGED( Name ), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Integration User' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Asset name can only be edited by integration
